statement: O7. Read the pack in a bounded way: call search_pack first, then call read_pages only for pages a search result names, and do not read a page again once it has been returned. Submit as soon as every item the step requires cites a page you have read; the Limits line caps the pack tool calls in one step.
applies_when: the step offers both search_pack and read_pages (compose.tool_names(spec))
absent_when: the step offers neither pack tool, or only one of them
why: Model-testing live pilot 2026-11-02: opus-medium and deepseek-max hit the per-step pack-tool cap in source_readiness before submitting (MANAGER relay; PF-R1).
